# Wenhui (Kit) Kang — Kit Kong

> Engineer in Burnaby, BC (Vancouver area), building AI systems, low-latency trading infrastructure and data products. MSc Applied Computer Science (Fairleigh Dickinson University, 2026), BBA Finance (Simon Fraser University). Co-founder of RootData. Open to AI, full-stack and data engineering roles. Contact: kitstation@163.com.

This file follows llmstxt.org. Every figure on the site traces to the project's own repo, logs or docs; simulations and backtests are labelled as such, and no page reports live trading returns. A longer, text-only version of the writing is at https://blog.kitkong.xyz/llms-full.txt.

## Projects

- [LLM-Digest](https://blog.kitkong.xyz/work/llm-digest): a self-hosted AI analyst. Every hour it reads 127 sources and runs a nine-stage LLM pipeline with typed hand-offs and a fallback model per stage; a RAG chat agent fuses SQLite FTS5/BM25 with 12 web sources by reciprocal rank fusion; 4,100+ reports. Next.js 16, React 19, Vercel AI SDK v6, SQLite. Live at https://llm.kitkong.xyz.
- [KV-cache LLM serving](https://blog.kitkong.xyz/work/kv-cache): graduate capstone, team of four. Owned the KV-cache layer under a learning-to-rank vLLM scheduler on an RTX 3090: 4-bit KV fit 2.83× the tokens, mean time to first token 10.7 s → 1.6 s at 64 req/s, preemptions 171 → 40; block-sparse Triton decode kernels. Python, vLLM, Triton, PyTorch.
- [Solana MEV and Jito relay](https://blog.kitkong.xyz/work/solana-mev): a Go, later Rust, gRPC bundle relay across eight Jito block-engine regions and 4,000+ egress IPs, designed for 30,000–60,000 requests a second; a shared atomic limiter and min-heap ready queue cut proxy wait from 13–28 ms to under 0.5 ms; market research on Solana arbitrage from public chain data.
- [Polymarket BTC bot](https://blog.kitkong.xyz/work/polymarket): a Rust trading system for 5- and 15-minute BTC Up/Down markets. Hand-written Binance SBE decoder about 1.65 s ahead of the Chainlink settlement feed; Black-Scholes N(d2) fair value behind eight entry gates; a live-parity backtester over 17,549 markets, sweeps of up to 100,800 configurations, LightGBM gate models. Main author, 720 of 894 commits.
- [RootData](https://blog.kitkong.xyz/work/rootdata): co-founder of a crypto asset database; designed and collected the database from zero; grew to 428K users and 200+ API partners; open-sourced MCP servers that expose about 20 tools to AI agents. Live at https://www.rootdata.com.
- [Payment indexer](https://blog.kitkong.xyz/work/paymentindexer): rebuilds stablecoin card-payment volume from self-indexed chain data; 22 of 24 card programs traced, within ±0.6% of the public benchmark on EVM mainnets. TypeScript, ClickHouse, Postgres.
- [WestTelecom](https://blog.kitkong.xyz/work/westtelecom): a bilingual telecom plan catalogue on Next.js and Sanity, shown as a fictional brand. Demo at https://westtelecom-demo.vercel.app.
